description: When the test suite fails inside a flow (the Stage 3 executor measurement run and the Stage 4 resolver pre-push run), the engine marks the turn failed and halts. Nothing records which tests failed or why, nothing classifies the failure, and nothing tries to fix it. Two flows halted on the same two tests because the review loop's git identity environment leaked into the child test run, and the cause was found only by hand.
goal: Add a test-failure loop around the two test runs. (1) Record: every failed run appends one row to the flow's own execution ledger fragment through the existing ledger append API (no new ledger, no ledger module edited) carrying run id, stage, head SHA, failing test ids, a redacted output excerpt per test and a scrubbed environment summary. (2) Diagnose: re-run only the failing ids in the same environment, in a scrubbed environment (no GIT_AUTHOR_* or GIT_COMMITTER_* variables, clean HOME and TMPDIR) and on the merged base, and classify the failure as introduced, flaky, environment or pre-existing. (3) Fix: an introduced failure goes to a fix turn with the classification, ids and excerpts; flaky tests are re-run up to a bounded count and recorded; environment and pre-existing failures are reported as blocked with the evidence rather than halting silently. (4) Re-run the full selection after each fix until it passes. (5) If the same failure signature repeats after a fix, step up one model tier; when the ladder is exhausted, stop with the full recorded trail. Put the logic in new small modules under apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/entrypoint/ and wire them from the two existing test-run call sites with minimal edits. Code is self-explaining: names state the intent; no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: A failed test run is evidence. Recording, classifying and fixing it in a loop removes manual diagnosis and stops one environment defect from halting several flows.
acceptance_criteria: A failed test run in the Stage 3 measurement and in the Stage 4 pre-push run appends a row with the failing ids, redacted excerpts and the classification.
An introduced failure triggers a fix turn and a re-run; the flow continues when the suite passes.
A flaky test is re-run and recorded; an environment or pre-existing failure stops with blocked evidence instead of a bare halt.
A failure caused by a leaked GIT_AUTHOR_* or GIT_COMMITTER_* variable is classified environment within one iteration.
A repeated failure signature after a fix steps up one tier; an exhausted ladder stops with the recorded trail.
Tests for each classification path use a fake test runner; no network access; uv run pytest passes.
No docstrings and no comments other than '# why:' are added; no file outside the scope list changes; the module budgets file and every budget-check script are untouched.

apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/entrypoint/test_failure_record.py, test_failure_classify.py and test_failure_loop.py hold the record, classify and loop logic, each covered by apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_test_failure_record.py, test_test_failure_classify.py and test_test_failure_loop.py.
apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/entrypoint/executor_test_run.py and apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/local_tests.py call the loop with minimal edits.
Existing tests apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_review_local_tests.py and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_executor_test_run.py pass, edited only for the new call signature.
